notes.en:
• Sign in to api.90z.cn in your system browser and automatically sync the conversational models allowed for your WcSdAi account.
• Recharge on the website, then refresh your account after the balance is credited; no API key or endpoint entry is needed for account models.
• Manage desktop sessions while preserving your existing API providers, local conversations and permission settings.
• Download and install this update manually; the app does not install updates automatically.
notes.zh-CN:
• 在系统浏览器中登录 api.90z.cn 并授权，自动同步 WcSdAi 账号允许使用的对话模型。
• 在网站充值，余额实际到账后刷新客户端账号即可使用，无需为账号模型填写 API Key 或接口地址。
• 支持管理桌面登录会话，保留原有 API 服务商、本地对话与权限设置。
• 点击更新提示进入下载页后手动安装，客户端不会自动安装更新。
